title: Design System: All Saints Mushililie — Academy & Parish

display.purpose: Home hero only — 'Faith. Mind. Character.' at 0.98 line-height, -0.03em tracking.

headline.purpose: One serif h1 per page; section h2s. Never sans.

body.purpose: Proof lines, notes, FAQ answers; measure 52–75ch on system sans.

label.purpose: Small-caps form labels, band markers, captions. #6f5410 on light, #d9a441 on dark.

shadows.name: ambient-stained-glass
shadows.purpose: The one deep ambient lift; bound to the home ribbon panel.

shadows.name: visitor-book-under-edge
shadows.purpose: 1px gold resting seam under the visitor-book card — a light edge, not a drop shadow.

motion.name: ribbon-glow
motion.purpose: One-time glow of the Chapel shaft on load: opacity 0.55→1→0.92, saturate/brightness bloom, then settles.

motion.name: ribbon-shimmer
motion.purpose: A single shaft of white gradient sweeping the ribbon once. Never loops.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Both ribbon animations are disabled when the user asks for reduced motion.

components.name: Gold Button (Primary CTA)
components.description: The door CTA — gold field, ink serif bold uppercase label; hover deepens to #e6b654.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #d9a441; color: #1f2a44; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #e6b654; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f5f3ed, 0 0 0 4px #d9a441; } .ds-btn-gold:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ink Button (Office Send)

components.name: Visitor Book

components.html:
Sign the visitor book

components.name: Stained-Glass School Day (Ribbon)
components.description: The home hero's continuous day: seven gradient shafts in fixed order under an arch-top; Chapel glows once on load.
components.css: .ds-ribbon { margin: 0; } .ds-ribbon-arch { overflow: hidden; border: 2px solid rgba(31,42,68,0.25); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 14% 14% 0 0; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(31,42,68,0.55); display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-shaft { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; min-height: 56px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.25); color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-shaft:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-shaft span { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.9; } .ds-shaft b { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-shaft-flag { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #c94a3a, #8e2a3c); } .ds-shaft-chapel { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #e9bc55, #c98f1e); color: #241703; } .ds-shaft-lessons { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1e6d82, #0e3f4f); } .ds-shaft-play { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2e6b4f, #1f4d33); } .ds-shaft-duty { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #8a6a42, #4a3220); } .ds-shaft-games { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #4b5aa8, #232c5e); } .ds-shaft-vespers { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #6a4a8a, #33204f); } .ds-ribbon-cap { margin-top: 8px; text-align: center; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(31,42,68,0.7); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-shaft-chapel { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-faq { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(31,42,68,0.12); padding: 16px 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-faq-q { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1f2a44; } .ds-faq-q::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq-plus { color: #6f5410; font-size: 20px; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-faq[open] .ds-faq-plus { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-a { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 48rem; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(31,42,68,0.8); } .ds-faq-q:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9a441; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The shipped public world (`src/app/(public)/*`, `src/components/public/*`, `src/app/globals.css`) is a chapel at 7:10 a.m., not a brochure: a cool whitewash ground, deep chapel ink, timber walnut, and morning gold used only as light. The category default (photo-collage hero + three icon cards) and the cream-brochure rendition were rejected outright; in their place a full-height "nave" first viewport pairs the word and the visitor-book form on the left with a stained-glass school-day ribbon on the right, and every page after deepens the same offer — book a visit. Serif in full ink contrast; humanist system sans for the reader; crisp edges and working parts, never fog, never haze.

Anglican identity is non-negotiable in tone — reverent, warm, community-rooted; never corporate or salesy. All content is labelled illustrative demo copy, swappable without layout change. The public route group renders without `PortalShell`; signed-in users are handed to `/login`. Light Kiswahili is welcome where natural.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous act of light: the ribbon, the hairline arch, gold as scarce light (CTA, icons, underlines, selection), never as decorative wash
Full ink contrast on whitewash; nothing fogged
Ledger rows and dividing hairlines instead of card grids
Georgia-class serif voices the institution; system sans serves the reader
Two shadows in the entire system, ever
Authored SVG geometry only (arch, crest, map, ribbon) — no photographs ship

rules.name: The Gold-As-Light Rule
rules.body: On light grounds gold (#d9a441) is graphics only — icons, underlines, dots, the 1px form under-edge — because it sits near 2:1 on whitewash. Small-caps text on light uses Deep Gold (#6f5410). Gold carries bold text only on dark grounds (ink, green).

rules.name: The Rare Ruby Rule
rules.body: Ruby appears exactly twice in the system: the ribbon's flag shaft terminus and the visitor-book error message. Adding a third use is a system violation, not a palette extension.

rules.name: The 12-to-1 Rule
rules.body: Ink on whitewash computes to roughly 12.8:1. Keep primary text there, secondary ink text at ≥/70 opacity (≈5:1), and reserve /60–/65 for genuinely non-essential print. The finish review signed off this floor; do not thin it further.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif names; sans serves. Never set long-form body in serif; never set the wordmark or display lines in sans.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: A third shadow is a bug. Focus is expressed with the gold ring (`focus:ring-2 ring-[#d9a441]/40` + border shift), never with shadow; disabled state is 60% opacity.

dos: Do carry body text as ink on whitewash (≈12.8:1); secondary ink at ≥/70 (≈5:1); Deep Gold #6f5410 for small-caps on light.
Do keep gold as light — on dark grounds for bold CTAs and icons; on light grounds for icons, underlines, focus rings, ::selection, and the visitor-book 1px under-edge.
Do end every page on the visit invitation; keep the visitor book reachable in the first viewport; never link the offer away to another page.
Do draw ornament as honest geometry — arch, crest, chapel map, ribbon — as CSS/SVG only.
Do divide ledgers with hairlines (#1f2a44/10–/12), not cards; rows over grids.
Do label demo figures illustrative and keep them swappable without layout change; no invented dates, founding stories, or staff.
Do keep keyboard focus visible everywhere: gold ring on fields, gold stroke on map spots, aria-current in nav, role="status" on the visitor-book success panel.
Do keep the two shipped shadows only; focus and disabled are ring/opacity, not elevation.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — ribbon glow and shimmer are disabled, not slowed.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or reuse ruby outside its two sanctioned uses (ribbon flag terminus, visitor-book error).
Don't set gold #d9a441 text on whitewash (≈2:1) — not for labels, not for 'accent' words; that is what Deep Gold is for.
Don't ship external fonts, images, map tiles, or CDN assets — the system renders from system stacks and authored SVG alone.
Don't wrap public pages in PortalShell, and don't style Portal login as a gold CTA — it is a quiet ink outline.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow above any heading, gradient text, or icon-card grids — the heading carries its own weight; ledger rows carry the content.
Don't add a third shadow, hard offset shadows, or a 1px border under a wide soft shadow (ghost card).
Don't present illustrative content as fact (fees, dates, history, counts) — it stays labelled; the finish review shipped it that way.
Don't reorder or recolour the seven ribbon shafts — they are the school day, 07:10 to vespers, in order.
Don't put the serif on long-form body copy or the sans on the wordmark/display lines.
Don't let secondary text thin below /70 opacity when it carries meaning — the /60 tier is for notes and non-essential print only.
